title: Bug: Multi-line descriptions are not fully parsed by Claude
body:
**Agent Name**: All Agents
**Issue Type**: Bug
**Claude Code Version**: Latest

**Description**:
The current parser in the Claude Code environment appears to only read the first line of an agent's `description` field. If the description spans multiple lines, any text after the first line is ignored. This leads to incomplete agent descriptions when viewed via the `/agents` command, which can affect agent discoverability and user understanding of the agent's purpose.

**Steps to Reproduce**:
1. Place an agent template with a multi-line `description` into the local `~/.claude/agents/` directory.
2. In a Claude conversation, type the `/agents` command to open the agent list menu.
3. Use the arrow keys to navigate to the agent and select it to view its details.

**Expected Behavior**:
The entire multi-line description should be displayed in the agent's details view.

**Actual Behavior**:
Only the first line of the description is displayed.

**Additional Context**:
While the official Anthropic sub-agent documentation does not explicitly forbid multi-line descriptions, all provided examples use a single-line format. This fix aligns our agent collection with the observed behavior.

**Official Documentation:** [https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/sub-agents#file-format](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/sub-agents#file-format)

linked_prs.title: fix: Ensure all agent descriptions are single-line

## Description
This PR addresses a parsing issue where **Claude Code** only reads the first line of an agent's `description` field.

All agent files with multi-line descriptions have been updated to use a single-line format. This ensures that the entire description is correctly parsed and displayed when users inspect an agent, improving consistency and reliability across the collection.
